HanbokVisual.title: Classic Palace Hanbok Styles & Real Silhouettes
HanbokVisual.intro: Explore the three quintessential Korean palace styles: youthful pastel Princess/Prince, dignified traditional Queen/King, and luxurious ornate Royal ceremonial robes. Choose a style to instantly apply its palette to your personalized recommendation below.
HanbokVisual.genderToggleAria: Select feminine or masculine style reference
HanbokVisual.notice: These references display authentic cultural showcase photography and official heritage media. They are provided for styling inspiration and do not imply celebrity endorsement or rental shop inventory guarantees.

feminine.description: Soft, graceful, and photo-friendly. A classic choice for first-time Hanbok experiences and airy palace garden photos with luminous pastel layers.

masculine.description: Refined and youthful prince robe in bright cheerful tones, ideal for lighthearted palace strolling and couple photography.
masculine.alt: Prince style bright palace stroll Hanbok robe

feminine.description: Elegant, traditional, and dignified. A refined choice featuring richer jewel-tone silk and formal royal-court composure.
feminine.alt: Queen style ceremonial rich silk Hanbok

masculine.description: Dignified noble scholar dopo robe with wide sweeping sleeves and deep classic tones, evoking beloved period drama nobility.
masculine.alt: King style noble scholar dopo Hanbok robe

feminine.description: Luxurious, ornate, and ceremonial. Choose this for the most dramatic and richly decorated palace look with gold-leaf accents and regal presence.
feminine.alt: Royal grand court haute couture ceremonial Hanbok

masculine.description: High-ceremonial royal crown robe with bold embroidered gold emblems and commanding grandeur for maximum photographic impact.
masculine.alt: Royal crown ceremonial Hanbok robe with gold embroidery
